What Does The Name Haeil Mean?
s: The name Haeil (해일) is of Korean origin, derived from two Korean characters: "해" (hae) meaning "sea" or "ocean" and "일" (il) meaning "sun" or "day." This compound name literally translates to "sea sun" or "ocean day," evoking powerful imagery of the sun rising over or reflecting upon the ocean.
